notes.title: Demo Update #4 - Music + Gameplay
notes.content: [p]Hey![/p][p align="start"]Just pushed a new build with a few changes I’m quite excited about:[/p][list][*][p]The game’s a bit harder now — matches should be a tiny bit more challenging.[/p][/*][*][p]Tenzio (the purple team) got a revamp - they should be more dynamic now.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a stat wheel to the upgrade screen so it’s easier to see your build.[/p][/*][*][p]Trying to find a cool vibe with some new music.[/p][/*][*][p]Opponent AI [i]should[/i] be playing a little smarter (we’ll see…).[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]That’s the gist of it — thanks for playing and let me know how it feels![/p]

notes.title: Demo Update #3 - Locker room + controller support
notes.content: [p]Big update for the demo today! Thanks to everyone who’s been playing and sending feedback — this one makes the game smoother, clearer, and (hopefully) more fun to play.[/p][p align="start"][b]Here’s what’s new:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Upgraded Locker Room[/b] – new look and flow between matches.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rebalanced Gameplay[/b] – matches now feel tighter and more competitive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]More Intuitive Spike Aiming[/b] – spiking feels natural and responsive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Support[/b] – grab your gamepad and hit the court! (this is my first time trying controller support, if it doesn't work tell me ASAP!)[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]This version is a huge step toward the final feel of [i]Hangtime![/i] and I’m excited for you to try it out.[/p][p align="start"]👉 Play the demo now & don’t forget to wishlist to support development![/p]

notes.title: Demo Update #2 - Features + fixes
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! Thanks so much for all the feedback on the [i]Hangtime![/i] demo so far — I’ve been listening closely, and today’s update brings a bunch of improvements and fixes to make rallies smoother than ever.[/p][h3]🔧 What’s new:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Bugs squashed[/b] – cleaned up some pesky issues causing weird moments in matches.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Achievements added[/b] – start collecting your bragging rights![/p][/*][*][p][b]Sound settings menu[/b] – adjust the game to your perfect vibe.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Camera fixed (again!)[/b] – no more funny business, it should behave properly now.[/p][/*][*][p][b]AI setter improved[/b] – he covers tips!![/p][/*][*][p][b]Rebalancing[/b][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]This is just the beginning — controller support and more are coming soon 👀.[/p][p align="start"]Thanks for playing and keep spiking those wishlists![/p]

notes.title: Update #1: qol upgrades
notes.content: [p]Thanks for all the demo love! Today’s small QoL patch focuses on smoother play and less friction.[/p][p][/p][p]-3 touch rule implemented[/p][p]-Pause screen polished + updated[/p][p]-Gameplay rebalances here and there[/p][p]-Quit button[/p][p]-Serve camera[/p][p][/p][p]I'm interested to hear if any of you guys have beaten the demo yet :)[/p]
